firm_data.firm_name: The Law Office of Joseph C. Sette and Associates
firm_data.firm_description: The Law Office of Joseph C. Sette and Associates is an insurance defense firm. Joseph Sette has over 25 years of experience in the insurance defense industry.
notable_facts: Joseph C. Sette was previously a managing partner of one of the largest litigation firms serving the entire state of Florida.
The firm handles BI, PIP, UM, Subrogation and Homeowners for Plymouth Rock Assurance.

email.subject: AI for Insurance Defense Firms - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Joseph,

With your 25+ years in insurance defense and your background leading litigation across Florida, you know the pressure to deliver results with lean operations. Managing BI, PIP, and subrogation cases requires precision that most tools simply don't provide.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with smaller teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters to practices like yours: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by Uniondale on Thursday, April 10 to share how we're helping insurance defense firms compete and scale.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
